operator_case.source: the frozen full-3D operator diagnostic saved result
operator_case.consumption: read-only arrays and metadata; do not import or call the operator, MLS provider, field evaluator, or quadrature builder

prior_attempt.failure: reader expected basis_row_ids under static_solve_replay.registry; the pinned producer stores it directly under static_solve_replay

manufactured_case.geometry: cylinder x^2+y^2<=R^2, -L/2<=z<=L/2; straight z-axis front; crack cut x<0,y=0
manufactured_case.basis: global unshifted FRONT_F1 enrichment with continuous MLS; the exact vector is BASE=0 and every UZ FRONT_F1 coefficient=A*sqrt(R)
manufactured_case.qualification: manufactured benchmark only; parameters do not represent ceramic material or a locally moving crack front

required_saved_evidence: raw semantic stiffness K (162x162), units N/m
ordered source/component/basis/index registry and canonical IDs
27 source positions or the exact saved rigid-mode center, in metres
384 unique query positions and their volume/boundary partition
384x54 basis values and 384x54x3 basis gradients, units 1 and 1/m
384 exact displacements and 384 exact displacement gradients
128 exact full-vector boundary tractions, units Pa

physical_volume_moment_gauge.volume_measure: V=sum_q(volume_weight_q) over the same saved 256 actual quadrature rows
physical_volume_moment_gauge.centroid: volume-weighted centroid of the saved 256 volume positions
physical_volume_moment_gauge.matrix: C_lj=(1/V)*sum_q(w_q*r_l(x_q) dot N_j(x_q)); assemble from the saved ordered registry and basis values
physical_volume_moment_gauge.target: g_l=(1/V)*sum_q(w_q*r_l(x_q) dot u_exact(x_q)); use the saved exact field and retain its actual nonzero targets
physical_volume_moment_gauge.nonzero_target_check: for positive KIII, the normalized rotation about x has positive g; the actual value is computed from the saved 256-point quadrature

pre_solve_gate.spectrum: diagonally scale raw K for analysis only; require exactly six expected rigid near-zero modes, 156 positive modes, and zero significant negative modes
block_if: saved-result schema/hash/units/order/status is missing or inconsistent
any provider or field-reference row is UNKNOWN
K, f, gauge, spectrum, or required saved field is non-finite
K has non-positive diagonal entries needed for scaling
the expected six-mode spectrum gate fails
the six physical rigid vectors do not span the six-mode nullspace
the six moment constraints do not control all six physical rigid modes
pre_solve_gate.failure_policy: BLOCKED; no solve, no partial displacement promotion, and no matrix repair

solve.method: direct dense solve after reversible diagonal and constraint-row scaling; retain and report raw K, C, f, and g

post_solve_checks.rigid_virtual_work: record all six rigid-vector dot load values with the integrated side/top/bottom/total force and moment
post_solve_checks.field_comparison: compare the solved field and its six engineering strains only at the saved 256 volume rows; report separately from exact manufactured coefficients/field
